concerns.text: The OLS models (T020‑T022) assume independent observations, yet the data are spatially indexed. No step addresses spatial autocorrelation (e.g., using spatial lag models, cluster‑robust SEs, or variogram checks). Ignoring spatial dependence can inflate Type I error rates and bias coefficient estimates, threatening the validity of the associational claims.

Power is only reported post‑hoc (Cohen’s f² and achieved power). There is no a priori sample‑size calculation or justification that the available records provide ≥ 0.80 power for the effect sizes of interest. Without this, the study may be under‑powered, and non‑significant results could be misinterpreted as evidence of no association.

concerns.text: The model includes climate and basic geographic covariates but omits other plausible confounders (e.g., habitat type, phylogenetic relatedness, seasonality). The plan does not discuss how omitted variable bias will be assessed or mitigated, leaving the estimated relationships vulnerable to spurious associations.

concerns.location: plan.md:# Phase / Task Mapping (covers every FR & SC)
concerns.text: The plan relies on a pre‑merged ‘AnalysisDataset’ without any validation of the merge quality (e.g., checking for mismatched species IDs or coordinate precision loss). This limits construct validity because measurement error introduced during the original merge cannot be detected or corrected.
